jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Operations Manager

What we believe in:

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

Your role and tasks

Are you looking to combine your studies with practical IT experience and gain insight into how IT supports a global organization?

We are looking for a Student Worker to join the Information Systems Infrastructure team in Middelfart. In this role, you will support daily IT operations while gaining hands-on experience across several IT disciplines, including infrastructure, workplace technology, business applications, cybersecurity, compliance, and user support. The position offers the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in practice while working alongside experienced colleagues who will support your learning and development.

You will become part of the local IT organization supporting ABB's operations in Denmark, working with both local and global colleagues to ensure stable and efficient IT services. The role is designed to provide meaningful practical experience while allowing you to gradually take on more responsibility as your skills and experience grow.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day IT operations and general IT-related activities

• Assisting with IT hardware, workplace equipment, and infrastructure-related tasks

• Providing practical IT support and assistance to end users

• Supporting activities related to business applications and systems

• Assisting with user administration and access-related activities

• Maintaining IT documentation, inventories, and relevant records

• Supporting IT compliance activities, controls, documentation, and follow-up

• Participating in smaller IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications for the role

• Currently pursuing a relevant higher education within IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Digitalization, or a related field

• Interest in IT technologies and motivation to develop practical IT skills

• Ability to organize and prioritize tasks in a structured and responsible manner

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with colleagues across functions

• Service-oriented approach and interest in supporting users and business stakeholders

• Interest in infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, compliance, or IT operations

• Effective communication skills in both Danish and English

• Experience with Microsoft technologies, IT support, scripting, applications, or infrastructure is an advantage but not a requirement

More about us

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences.

You can look forward to joining a workplace that values employee well-being. We put a lot of focus on a positive work environment and invest in ongoing development for you and your colleagues.

The role is based in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model, combining office collaboration with flexibility to work remotely when appropriate. You will contribute to a cooperative workplace in which knowledge exchange and cross-team collaboration play a central role.

If you’d like to learn more about our efforts around workplace environment and sustainability, you can read more here: ABB Sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart alongside your IT colleagues. We offer flexibility with the possibility of working from home when appropriate while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

The position reports to Jimmy Frederiksen.

Apply for the job online, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Jimmy Frederiksen at +45 44 50 40 89.

The application deadline is 29.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable, and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 110,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 550 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg. Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

#RunWithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a talented student assistant to strengthen our embedded systems work.

As Student Assistant in Embedded Systems, you will develop the firmware that brings our photonics lab setups to life. Working closely with our engineering team, you will build STM32-based systems for signal generation, acquisition, processing, and monitoring, turning hardware into working, measurable systems. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity, and expectation, to see your code run on real lab equipment from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers, ensuring robust, well-structured code that supports our lab setups and experiments.

Interfaces & Device Control: Connect, configure, and control external devices over SPI and I2C, while ensuring reliable communication between the microcontroller and the surrounding hardware.

Signal Generation, Acquisition & Processing: Generate signals and waveforms, acquire and monitor analog signals, and process the acquired data on the MCU through filtering, averaging, and feature extraction.

Lab Work & Documentation: Bring up and debug hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers, while documenting code and results clearly and maintaining version control with Git.

What We Are Looking For

Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related discipline.

Embedded Experience: You bring good knowledge of C and microcontroller fundamentals along with practical experience with STM32 or comparable ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

Interfaces & Peripherals: You have hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, DMA, timers, ADC, and DAC, from configuring the peripheral to debugging it on the bench.

Electronics: You are able to read and understand electronic circuits, schematics, and datasheets. Electronics skills such as circuit design, soldering, and measurement, as well as real-world lab experience, are considered an advantage. Experience with PCB design (KiCad or Altium) and Python or MATLAB for data analysis is a plus.

Soft Skills: You are a structured and independent problem-solver who enjoys working at the boundary between hardware and software, communicates effectively with colleagues, and thrives in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required.

The Perks

We care about your growth and development. You will work on cutting-edge photonics and embedded technology alongside highly motivated colleagues, with access to a well-equipped lab. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams, a positive culture with free snacks, and the opportunity to write your Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis with us.

How To Apply

If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV, a current transcript of records, and a few lines about an embedded project you have worked on (a link to a Git repository is a plus). We aim to fill the position as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

For more information or questions please contact us at haris@phanofi.com

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

________________________________________________________________

We treat all candidates equally, are committed to bringing in top talent from all sectors and countries, and will not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

Do you want to help shape the strategic direction of Dalux’s international bid activities? And are you motivated by bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives to develop strong bid strategies? Then you might be our new Bid Manager!

**First, who on earth is Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish-owned international software company that digitises the construction and facilities management industries. Our solutions within BIM and digital project management are used by contractors, building owners, and consultants in more than 170 countries. With more than 50 offices and colleagues across 28 countries, we are in the midst of an exciting growth journey.

**A key role with strategic responsibility

**As Bid Manager at Dalux, you will play a central role in our commercial strategy and be responsible for driving and further developing a professional, international bid function based in Copenhagen.

You will be at the centre of our bid activities across markets and countries, bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives into one cohesive strategy. Working closely with Sales, Legal, senior management, and technical specialists, you will ensure that our bids are competitive, legally sound, and strategically prioritised.

The majority of our tenders come from international markets, meaning you will play an important role in understanding and navigating different countries’ regulations, cultures, and approaches to tender processes.

**Your key responsibilities will include:

**

• Driving and further developing a centralised bid function responsible for tender and bid processes across markets.

• Developing and shaping bid strategies in close collaboration with senior management and relevant commercial teams.

• Conducting strategic bid/no-bid assessments to ensure that Dalux prioritises the opportunities with the strongest strategic fit and greatest potential for success.

• Analysing tender documentation, identifying risks and opportunities, and challenging the basis for our participation.

• Ensuring legal quality and effective risk management in collaboration with our Legal team.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams throughout complex bid processes and ensuring progress, structure, and quality.

• Gathering and applying market and competitor insights to strengthen Dalux’s position.

• Continuously optimising processes and ways of working to make the bid function more efficient and create space for strategic work.

**This sounds like a great fit for me!

**We imagine that you have solid experience with tender and bid processes, for example as a Bid Manager, Senior Bid Specialist or so. You have a strong understanding of public and private bids and tender regulations, including relevant EU rules, and can translate legal requirements into commercial decisions.

You are interested in working internationally and motivated by learning about new markets, cultures, and local interpretations of regulations and tender processes. International experience is an advantage, but your curiosity and desire to work across borders are just as important. You communicate confidently in English.

The role is first and foremost about setting the direction, driving the process, and ensuring quality across our bids. You will not necessarily be responsible for producing large volumes of bid material yourself. Instead, you will be able to quality-assure, challenge, and bring together input from relevant commercial and technical colleagues to create a strong and cohesive proposal.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and strategic in your approach. You have a natural project management overview and the ability to create structure and drive progress in complex processes involving many stakeholders.

You are confident in your professional expertise and have the maturity and composure needed to engage with different types of people from specialists and colleagues across our international organisation to managers and senior leadership. You are able to challenge and provide direction while remaining humble in your approach and bringing different perspectives together around a shared decision.

**Be part of Dalux’s success!

**At Dalux, we are committed to creating a workplace that inspires and motivates. We believe that wellbeing and job satisfaction go hand in hand with a healthy work environment which is why we believe excessive overtime should be a thing of the past.

We have an informal yet professional culture where everyone is welcome, without strict dress codes or unnecessary titles. You will become part of an engaged community where we do not just come together for work, but also for social activities such as shared dinners, workshops, wine tastings, knitting clubs, and running clubs or whatever we come up with next.

At our headquarters in Copenhagen, you will join a dedicated team in Business Operations, and you will collaborate and spar with colleagues across our offices in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and the rest of Europe. Wherever you are, you can expect a strong sense of community and a shared focus on innovation and success for both our customers and Dalux.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner with a focus on operations and supply chain transformation, Copenhagen or Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about helping clients solve complex supply chain challenges and create lasting business value? Do you combine deep functional expertise with commercial acumen, strong client relationships and leadership experience? Are you also curious about how AI, data and digital capabilities can strengthen future operations? Then you could play a key role in growing our Supply Chain & Operations practice and leading high-impact transformations.

**About Valcon

**We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape and fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

**To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these three competence areas:

**

• Commercial growth: Build strong client relationships, identify opportunities and contribute to the growth of existing and new client engagements through trusted advisory and business development activities

• Client engagement: Lead complex supply chain and operational improvement transformations from problem definition and solution design through implementation and value realization.

• Capability development: Help strengthen Supply Chain & Operations offerings, methodologies and market presence while leveraging AI, data and technology as key enablers of transformation

**In Addition, You Should Embody These Skills

**

• Supply Chain & Operations expertise: Deep experience within one or more areas such as Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Logistics/Distribution, Procurement, Operational Excellence and Supply Chain Transformation

• People leadership: Build strong relationships, inspire teams and create an environment where people feel empowered, supported and motivated to perform

• Commercial and consulting acumen: Combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic delivery mindset and a strong understanding of how to create value for clients and grow trusted partnerships

• Digital mindset: Experience working with data, digital solutions and technology, or a strong curiosity about how these can enable better supply chain performance and business transformation

• Education: Relevant Master’s degree, fluent in English both written and spoken, Danish is a plus

**Career opportunities

**Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

**Role

**The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex Supply Chain and Operation projects in the business and technology space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

**Application

**If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**💰Salary Based On Your Experience And Seniority Level

**🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.occupation: 3-year PhD Position in CRISPR-Based Genome Editing
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a full-time, 3-year PhD position in CRISPR-based genome editing, with a preferred starting date of 1st of January 2027.

The Research Group

The project will be conducted in the research group led by Chief Physician Maria Rossing at MDxCore, Rigshospitalet, and is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Our group consists of six dedicated researchers working within genomic medicine and translational research. We offer a collaborative research environment and excellent facilities in modern laboratories at Rigshospitalet.

Project Details

CRISPR-based genome editing offers the potential to correct disease-causing genetic variants at their source. Recent clinical successes demonstrate that precise, patient-specific genome editing is feasible, but such approaches remain exceptional and have not yet been translated into systematic therapeutic pipelines for rare disorders. This project aims to develop a patient-tailored CRISPR-based therapy for Glanzmann thrombasthenia, a severe inherited bleeding disorder caused by defects in platelet integrin αIIbβ3. Focusing on pathogenic patient variants in the ITGA2B gene, we will establish a translational workflow spanning characterization of the genetic defect, development of relevant cellular models, optimization of genome-editing strategies, and assessment of functional rescue and editing safety. The most promising strategy will be evaluated in hematopoietic stem cells and preclinical models to assess efficacy, durability, and safety. The project will thereby establish a framework for translating individualized genome editing into potential therapies for rare genetic disorders.

Application deadline: 30st of November 2026, 23:59 CET

Preferred start date: 1st of January 2027

Duration: 3 years

Requirements

We are seeking a highly motivated and ambitious scientist with the following qualifications:

• A master’s in medicine, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field, completed before the application deadline

• Experience in CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing and molecular and cell biology

• Experience with cell culture and relevant molecular and biochemical techniques

• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary research team

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• A strong interest in translational research and the development of novel genome-editing therapies

Place of Employment

The position is based in the Rossing Research Group at MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry, Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark. Rigshospitalet is one of Denmark's leading university hospitals and is located centrally in Copenhagen.

Terms of Employment

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for three years. The average working week is 37 hours. Salary, pension, and other terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for employees in the Danish Regions.

Application

The application must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” no later than 31st of November 2026 at 23:59 (Copenhagen local time).

The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

• Letter of motivation describing previous research experience, research interests, and career plans (maximum 1 page)

• CV including education, research/work experience, language skills, and other relevant skills

• Copy of Master's degree certificate

• Transcripts of relevant previous degrees

• List of publications

• Letter(s) of recommendation (optional)

Applications received by email or through other platforms cannot be accepted.

Recruitment Process

Eligible applicants will be assessed based on their CV, motivation letter, qualifications, and submitted documentation. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an on-site or online interview. All applicants will be notified once the recruitment process has been completed.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact:

Maria Rossing

Professor, Chief Physician

MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry

Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital

caroline.maria.rossing@regionh.dk

_Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

jobs.occupation: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

• 
Good communication and collaborative skills

• 
Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

• 
Can work independently and have a good overview

• 
IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

• 
Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Head Baker Wanted – Night Production

Helges Ost & Bageri ApS

We are looking for a skilled and responsible Head Baker to lead and coordinate our night-time bakery production and supervise the bakery team.

About the position

As Head Baker, you will be responsible for the daily night production, ensuring that our products meet our quality standards and that production runs efficiently and smoothly.

You will take an active part in the production while supervising and coordinating the work of other bakery employees. You will be responsible for daily task allocation, staff scheduling and ensuring that the team performs its duties correctly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities

Leading and coordinating daily night-time bakery production.

Actively participating in baking bread, rolls and other bakery products.

Supervising bakery employees and ensuring that tasks are performed correctly and according to established standards.

Planning staff schedules and coordinating shift coverage.

Distributing daily tasks and monitoring employee performance.

Training and guiding bakery employees in production methods, quality standards and daily routines.

Maintaining consistent product quality and ensuring compliance with recipes and production procedures.

Ensuring efficient workflows and timely completion of production.

Monitoring compliance with hygiene, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

Maintaining cleanliness and order in the bakery.

Reporting operational issues and staffing needs to management.

We expect you to

Be a qualified baker or have solid professional experience in bakery production.

Have experience supervising or coordinating the work of other employees.

Be capable of organising staff schedules and daily production tasks.

Have strong leadership and communication skills.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility for the daily production and team.

Have a strong focus on quality, craftsmanship and efficiency.

Be reliable, well-organised and able to work efficiently in a busy environment.

We offer

A permanent position of 37 hours per week.

A responsible, hands-on supervisory role with a high degree of independence.

Responsibility for coordinating the night production and supervising the bakery team.

Salary based on qualifications and experience.

The opportunity to become an important part of a dedicated bakery team.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We look forward to hearing from you!
